remarks: Beautifully renovated 2-story 3+2.5 Mission Oaks home w/ new custom tile, laminate flooring and wood-like staircase, central air, ceiling fan-lights in bedrooms, new window blinds and plumbing fixtures and freshly painted interior plus much much more. Well designed kitchen with custom tiled backsplash, granite counters, under cabinet lighting, Viking range, new built in MW, stainless refrigerator, DW and farm sink w/ accessories. Living room w/ FP  &  adjacent sitting room, breakfast counter that  opens to formal dining area w/ patio access and updated guest 1/2 bath on the lower level. Atrium like stairway with wood like steps, leads to the bedrooms. Spacious Master suite and on-suite
